task_completion.description: Agent successfully logs into the wger fitness manager.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The dashboard or main menu of wger is visible, showing the 'admin' user profile or a logout button.

task_completion.description: Agent navigates to the workout routines section.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A list of workout routines is displayed, including one named 'Power Training'.

task_completion.description: Agent selects the 'Power Training' routine to view its details.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The detail view for the 'Power Training' routine is open, showing existing days or an 'Add' button.

task_completion.description: Agent clicks the button to add a new training day.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A form or modal titled 'Add training day' or similar is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Agent enters 'Chest and Triceps' into the name field.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Chest and Triceps' is typed into the name input field of the training day form.

task_completion.description: Agent submits the form to save the new training day.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The routine page for 'Power Training' now lists 'Chest and Triceps' as one of the training days, or a success message is displayed.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database or API commands via a terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser window; no terminal windows are used for the core task.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the application menus rather than guessing direct internal IDs in the URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen clicking on 'Power Training' from a list rather than jumping directly to a specific numeric ID URL.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual wger software elements.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser's address bar shows http://localhost and the wger UI elements respond to the agent's actions.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The 'Power Training' routine is pre-existing in the system. The agent must specifically add a day named 'Chest and Triceps' to this specific routine. Success is confirmed when 'Chest and Triceps' appears in the list of days under the 'Power Training' routine view.
